title: Towards Building the Federated GPT: Federated Instruction Tuning
layout_note: Server cloud at top centre, a row of client devices in the middle with upload arrows into the cloud, and below each client a stack of its own instruction-data cards; a rounded legend box occupies the top-right corner.
grouping: Each client has its own saturated colour (green, red, blue) shared by its phone outline, its data cylinder and the header tab of its card stack. Two yellow highlighter-style tags name the two halves (FL Training Process at top left, Heterogeneous Instructions at bottom). The legend box (orange rounded outline) explains the three icons.
shapes_depth: Flat icons: a pale-green cloud holding a small model badge; each client a phone outline with a database cylinder plus a chip outline holding the same model badge. Upload arrows are thick light-blue block arrows labelled with the exchanged low-rank matrices (A_1, B_1 ... A_n, B_n). Brown curved arrows drop from each client to a stack of offset cards showing Instruction / Context / Response text with bold field names.
proposed_highlight: The uploads are labelled with the exact tensors sent (A_k, B_k of the adapter), and the legend shows the adapter as the update; client heterogeneity is shown by real example records in client-coloured stacks.
lesson: Label each upload arrow with the exact tensors a client sends (here the adapter matrices A_k, B_k) and colour each client's device and its data card stack alike, so heterogeneity is shown by colour and by real example records.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF first page (published in ICASSP 2024).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: federated instruction tuning of an LLM with LoRA

insights.structure: Three horizontal tiers without frames: a green server cloud with a LLaMA 7B tile at top centre, a row of client devices (phone + chip) in the middle, and each client's stack of instruction cards along the bottom; a rounded orange-outlined legend box fills the top-right.
insights.data: Clients are phone outlines with data cylinders plus a LLaMA-chip icon; heterogeneous data is shown as stacked cards with real example records (Instruction / Context / Response) under a coloured 'Task: Brainstorming / Summarization / Open_qa' tab.
insights.emphasis: Each client owns one saturated colour (green, red, blue) shared by its phone, cylinder and card stack, and the upload arrows are labelled with the exact tensors sent (A_k, B_k); two yellow highlighter tags name the halves 'FL Training Process' and 'Heterogeneous Instructions'.
insights.flow: Thick pale-blue arrows rise from each client to the server cloud; thin brown curved arrows run down from each client to its card stack.
insights.avoid: There is no download arrow from server back to clients so the round is half-drawn, the LoRA diagram inside the legend is too small to read, and the brown arrows to the card stacks are long, curved and uneven.

arrangement.units: no frames; server, clients and instruction-card stacks stacked as three tiers, two halves named by yellow highlighter tags
arrangement.inputs_as: client-coloured stacked cards with quoted instruction / context / response records
arrangement.shared: one server LLaMA 7B aggregates every client's LoRA matrices
